title: CSV exports from Excel fail with 'missing required column(s): date'
statement:
Importing a CSV exported from Excel with the 'CSV UTF-8' option fails:

    >>> Ledger().import_csv('march.csv')
    ledgerlite.csvimport.CsvImportError: missing required column(s): date

The first header cell is clearly 'Date'. If I open the same file in a text editor and re-save it, it imports fine. The module docstring says spreadsheet exports that start with a UTF-8 byte-order mark are supported. Both parse_transactions(text) and read_transactions(path) / Ledger.import_csv(path) need to accept these exports, including ones that use header aliases or quoted header cells.
